scope.sqlProfiles: Unchanged frozen plain-existing-column point R2 SELECT/UPDATE/native RETURNING
deploymentAssumptions: caller stops all business workers before quiesce
only newly wrapped connections after successful handoff
no external writer or raw connection bypass
no DDL/trigger/role/metadata changes between verification windows
controlled setup connection with standard tuple rows

api.create: EpochCoordinator.create(new_store, idle_autocommit_setup, schema=controlled_schema, keys=distinct_existing_keys, exclusive_writers=True, max_live=128)
api.business: coordinator.current.wrap(raw_connection); consume every result; commit/rollback; observe wrapper.close() returning with raw.closed=True
api.quiesce: caller = coordinator.quiesce(expected_generation=n); repeat same barrier idempotently returns the same token
api.handoff: coordinator.handoff(idle_setup, caller=caller, expected_generation=n, max_ledger=1024) returns a newly admitted observer only after protected persistence succeeds
api.finish: coordinator.finish(idle_setup, caller=caller, expected_generation=n, max_ledger=1024) seals the final epoch and verifies raw chain
api.inspect: EpochCoordinator(existing_store).verify_chain() independently replays fixed catalog queries and checks raw bindings/epoch continuity
api.recover: inspect-only exact owner nonce/token; never removes failure authority, resumes a writer, reruns DDL, or manufactures a COMMIT response

ordering: _local lock serializes barrier tokens and transitions; permanent native mutex serializes cooperating processes
after native acquisition, preflight rechecks generation/caller/current/phase/admission/on-disk manifest before new owner or intent
fsynced owner guard and intent remain through all boundary/sealing/publication writes
one actual setup BEGIN then actual opaque PID/transaction identity query then ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks on business+installation+audit+state
fixed catalog replayable observations, final snapshot, actual server-cursor bounded audit stream, second catalog observations and next snapshot all share this transaction
actual COMMIT command tag COMMIT and idle status precede ledger completion, old journal/source sealing and new consistent snapshot publication
old/new final boundary token maps must exactly match; same original UUIDs, never UUID/time/ACK ordering inference
generation manifest and intent cleanup are synchronized while owner guard and permanent native mutex remain held
only after protected sync succeeds is temporary owner guard removed; its deletion has no additional durability promise; permanent native mutex inode is never unlinked
only after mutex release succeeds does the method return a newly admitted wrapper source

failures.preflight: stale/wrong/nonquiescent requests change no owner/intent/manifest and do not poison a valid caller
failures.beforeOrAtCommitPoint: source/write/fsync/intent/manifest/snapshot/COMMIT failures retain owner authority and poison live coordinator; secondary diagnostic marker failure does not remove owner
failures.unknownSetupCommit: even if later idle rollback returns, no complete boundary or resumed chain
failures.lateActivity: activity after quiescent barrier or after old sealing invalidates chain; business driver result/exception remains unchanged; pure repeated close is cleanup
failures.allMarkerWritesFail: live poison is unconditional; another process cannot universally learn a later event when every persistent write failed and original bytes remained unchanged
failures.postConfirmedCommitNativeRelease: live poison and best-effort owner/marker restoration; explicit cross-process detectability limit if all later writes fail; no relaxation of prior data/sync failure rules
failures.platform: Linux directory fsync request and Windows controlled no-op API are reported separately; no physical power-cut durability certification

resultSemantics.valid: false on guard/poison/corrupt/missing/raced/inconsistent chain evidence; valid running raw chain can still be incomplete
resultSemantics.rawEpochChainComplete: only closed contiguous raw epoch journals + bound/replayed setup evidence; not complete SQL coverage or dependency/source graph proof

limits: No automatic crash recovery, more than two epochs,4096 keys,60-second cost eligibility,archive-backed source graph,archive deletion,DB metadata GC,sidecar,CRUD/negative reads,ORM/async or generic SQL proof.
Connection close ACK means the original driver close returned and raw.closed=True; PostgreSQL has no server COMMIT-equivalent connection-close ACK.
The disk reference database is rebuildable metadata, not authority or a proven dependency graph. Raw SQL, intermediate/aborted/reverted facts and all old source remain.

Controlled catalog queries use the original verifier and may have normal driver PGresult buffering before the observer rejects a row/byte budget; this is not an arbitrary hostile-database query-memory firewall.
Hashes bind exact files for error detection; they do not authenticate the collector or protect against an administrator rewriting all facts and hashes.
